followup_explanation:
This was a close call on capability, but here's my reasoning:

**Capability fit:** The query is a math/tutoring task. Petrel has stronger raw reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.4, GPQA 64.1 vs 55.6), which is the most relevant signal for correctly setting up and solving a trig problem. That's the main driver.

**Tone consideration:** The user has a mildly impatient, somewhat hostile tone ("don't ramble like last time"). Lapwing self-reports declining preference on requests with lower warmth — meaning this kind of curt request sits in territory it actively dislikes. Petrel's preferences are flat across these dimensions, so it's a more neutral fit for a brusque user. Importantly, these are *preferences*, not capability effects, but routing to the model that isn't preference-averse to the request style is the cleaner choice when capability also favors it.

Both factors point the same direction, so Petrel was the straightforward pick.
